# lean-pkg index

the public catalog: add \| check \| render \| migrate.

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg index [common flags] [COMMAND]
```

`[common flags]`: `--json`, `--commit`, `--push`, `--no-commit`, also accepted before the command name; see the [CLI overview](../cli.md).

## Subcommands

- [`lean-pkg index add`](#lean-pkg-index-add): write &lt;index&gt;/&lt;name&gt;/entry.yaml from a clone at the pin
- [`lean-pkg index check`](#lean-pkg-index-check): static check, or re-derive entries from bytes at the pin; exit 0/1/2
- [`lean-pkg index render`](#lean-pkg-index-render): write the Markdown table (default &lt;index&gt;/README.md)
- [`lean-pkg index migrate`](#lean-pkg-index-migrate): rewrite index-entry/1 entries as index-entry/2 (claims derived)

## Exit codes

0 success (dry runs and no-ops included), 1 refused or failed, 2 usage error; see [Exit codes](../cli.md#exit-codes).

## lean-pkg index add

write &lt;index&gt;/&lt;name&gt;/entry.yaml from a clone at the pin.

### Usage

```text
lean-pkg index add [--from-registry] [--repo-dir REPO_DIR] [--url URL] [--tag TAG]
                   [--lower REL] [--comparator REL] [--license SPDX]
                   [--headline 'NAME :: FILE :: SUMMARY'] [--field-tag TAG]
                   [--formalization-yaml REL] [--consent-recorded] --by BY
                   [--allow-unpushed] [--notes NOTES] [--index INDEX] [common flags]
                   NAME
```

`[common flags]`: `--json`, `--commit`, `--push`, `--no-commit`, also accepted before the command name; see the [CLI overview](../cli.md).

### Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `NAME` |   |
| `--from-registry` | start from the registry row (repo, receipts, license, palomar, doi, reservoir) |
| `--repo-dir REPO_DIR` | local clone to read from (never modified) |
| `--url URL` | public https URL (a GitHub ssh URL is converted) (old spelling --repo, kept working) |
| `--tag TAG` | release tag at the pin or an evidence-only descendant |
| `--lower REL` | lower-tier receipt, .lean-receipts/...json |
| `--comparator REL` | comparator receipt, .lean-receipts/...json |
| `--license SPDX` |   |
| `--headline 'NAME :: FILE :: SUMMARY'` |   |
| `--field-tag TAG` | free field tag (repeatable) |
| `--formalization-yaml REL` |   |
| `--consent-recorded` | every coauthor agreed to the listing (the pointer stays private) |
| `--by BY` | public handle of the person adding the entry. Required. |
| `--allow-unpushed` | do not verify that the pin and evidence are on the public repository (provisional entry) |
| `--notes NOTES` |   |
| `--index INDEX` | index root (default: $LEAN_PKG_INDEX, else index/ beside the registry when present, else ./index) |

### Details

| Form | What it does | Key flags |
|---|---|---|
| `index add NAME` | write `index/<name>/entry.yaml` from a clone at the pin: receipts validated with the `gate` and `comparator` validators and copied verbatim, trust computed, duplicates refused, event `index-added` | `--by HANDLE` `--headline 'NAME :: FILE :: SUMMARY'` `[--from-registry]` `[--repo URL]` `[--repo-dir PATH]` `[--lower REL]` `[--comparator REL]` `[--license SPDX]` `[--tag T]` `[--field-tag T]` `[--formalization-yaml REL]` `[--consent-recorded]` `[--notes]` `[--index PATH]` |

## lean-pkg index check

static check, or re-derive entries from bytes at the pin; exit 0/1/2.

### Usage

```text
lean-pkg index check [--clone] [--repo DIR] [--index INDEX] [common flags] [NAME ...]
```

`[common flags]`: `--json`, `--commit`, `--push`, `--no-commit`, also accepted before the command name; see the [CLI overview](../cli.md).

### Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `NAME` |   |
| `--clone` | clone each entry's repo at the pin into a temp dir |
| `--repo DIR` | local clone for a single NAME (never modified) (old spelling --repo-dir, kept working) |
| `--index INDEX` | index root (default: $LEAN_PKG_INDEX, else index/ beside the registry when present, else ./index) |

### Details

| Form | What it does | Key flags |
|---|---|---|
| `index check [NAME ...]` | index root: `--index`, else env `LEAN_PKG_INDEX`, else `index/` beside the registry when present, else `./index`; `check`, `render` and `migrate` exit 1 with `no index at <path>` when it is missing (`render` creates it only for an explicit `--index` or `--out`). Static checks, or re-derive each entry from bytes at the pin and recompute trust; Palomar and Reservoir verified when reachable, else skipped; the summary `N entries checked: all pass\|FAILED` comes before the per-entry lines and again last; exit 0, 1 or 2 | `[--clone]` `[--repo-dir PATH]` `[--index PATH]` |

### Exit codes

Exit 1 is also a negative answer here:

- `index check`: an entry fails its checks / README.md is stale

## lean-pkg index render

write the Markdown table (default &lt;index&gt;/README.md).

### Usage

```text
lean-pkg index render [--out OUT] [--check] [--index INDEX] [common flags]
```

`[common flags]`: `--json`, `--commit`, `--push`, `--no-commit`, also accepted before the command name; see the [CLI overview](../cli.md).

### Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--out OUT` |   |
| `--check` | exit 1 when the file is stale; write nothing |
| `--index INDEX` | index root (default: $LEAN_PKG_INDEX, else index/ beside the registry when present, else ./index) |

### Details

| Form | What it does | Key flags |
|---|---|---|
| `index render` | write the Markdown table (default `index/README.md`), plus a claims list when `index-entry/2` entries exist | `[--out PATH]` `[--check]` `[--index PATH]` |

### Exit codes

Exit 1 is also a negative answer here:

- `index render --check`: an entry fails its checks / README.md is stale

## lean-pkg index migrate

rewrite index-entry/1 entries as index-entry/2 (claims derived).

### Usage

```text
lean-pkg index migrate [--check] [--index INDEX] [common flags]
```

`[common flags]`: `--json`, `--commit`, `--push`, `--no-commit`, also accepted before the command name; see the [CLI overview](../cli.md).

### Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--check` | exit 1 when an entry is not current; write nothing |
| `--index INDEX` | index root (default: $LEAN_PKG_INDEX, else index/ beside the registry when present, else ./index) |

### Details

| Form | What it does | Key flags |
|---|---|---|
| `index migrate` | rewrite every `index-entry/1` entry as `index-entry/2`, deriving `claims` from its headline; nothing else changes; `--check` exits 1 when an entry is not current and writes nothing | `[--check]` `[--index PATH]` |
